rules.statement: A demand for repayment of a loan repayable on demand will arise only at the time when a demand is made.
rules.supporting_quote: It is settled law that the cause of action concerning a loan repayable on demand will arise only at the time when a demand is made [Seylan Bank Ltd v. Inter Trade Garments (Pvt.) Ltd. (2005) 1 Sri.L.R 80; Sivasubramaniam v. Alagamutui (1950) 53 N.L.R 150; See also, Bank of Ceylon v. Flex Port (Pvt.) Ltd., SC Appeal 120/2012, S.C.M. 03.07.2020 at pages 6-7].
